optional.finding: The value counts eligible parameter/degree groups whose retained minimum ratio is below one, not all individual sampled polynomials with ratio below one.
optional.suggestion: For future runs, rename to parameter_degree_groups_below_one or maintain a separate in-loop sample hit counter.
optional.effect_on_current_result: None. A zero group count is equivalent to zero individual hits, and the full replay matches the reported no-hit result.
